_comment: Reproducible source for the deterministic OSM PBF spine transport (Epic
036) — Geofabrik regional .osm.pbf extracts, read directly by
ingestion/fetch/osm_pbf.py via pyosmium instead of querying live Overpass
mirrors. `scripts/fetch_osm_pbf.py` downloads the named state extract to
gitignored data/osm/; this manifest is the durable, checked-in record of
where it came from (mirrors regions/usfs_manifest.json's role for the USFS
bulk shapefile). Geofabrik terms: free, attribution required, no
hammering — download once, cache, refresh on a schedule; the PBF itself is
NEVER committed or downloaded in CI (a state extract runs ~386-398 MB).
OSM data via Geofabrik is licensed ODbL — already compliant
